risks.risk: Ink cartridges may be missing, empty, or dried up.
risks.proof: A photo of the internal cartridge bay or a printed supply status page.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full set of new cartridges

risks.risk: The print head may be clogged or the mechanical assembly failed.
risks.proof: A photo of a recent test print or nozzle check page.

risks.risk: The automatic document feeder (ADF) or scanner may be defective.
risks.proof: A short video of the device performing a copy or scan.

proof_requests: Photo of the model name (usually located on the front panel or near the screen).
Photo of the printer powered on showing the menu on the screen.
A photo of a test print or status report page printed by this machine.
response.reason: The specific model is not legible in the photos, which is necessary for accurate valuation. Additionally, there is no proof of power or functionality.
